title: AIAS Integrated Management System Foundation
purpose: Create one evidence-based management-system foundation for quality, information security, AI management and business continuity.
scope: Context, policy, ownership, risk, objectives, documented information, internal audit, management review, corrective action, high-level control families and external certification boundary.

requirements.title: Integrated foundation
requirements.statement: One common system shall govern four management domains and approved ISO targets.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Risk and objectives
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain owned, scored risks and measurable objectives without invented observations.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Assurance cycle
requirements.statement: The system shall support internal audits, management review and corrective actions with traceable evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: No self-certification
requirements.statement: Internal implementation and audits shall never authorize an external certification claim.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Licensed content boundary
requirements.statement: The system shall materialize only high-level common families until legitimate normative access is available for clause-level crosswalks.
requirements.rationale: Respect standards copyright and assessment accuracy.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Immediate consumer
requirements.statement: AIAS shall generate a real foundation state with four risks, four objectives, an audit program, management review and corrective action.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
